bio: Inside the Cantine Nervi, a contemporary restaurant where the kitchen is totally open, you can choose to eat on the large counter or at more classic tables. The young chef Matteo Piana delights in a contemporary and creative style. If it seems obvious that there is no lack of meat dishes, you will be pleasantly surprised by the presence of some incursions from the sea (try the raw tuna to dip in different tasty sauces, some of oriental inspiration). There is a good wine selection, naturally the house wines are the most represented: many also served by the glass....
